title: The Nether Update Again
description: This mod adds 2 new biomes, 4 new mobs, and a new ore to the Nether
body:
The Nether is expanding! This mod adds more diversity to the underworld with new colorful biomes, unique creatures, and a brand-new ore.

## New Biomes 🌲
Two new forests join the Nether, following the style of Crimson and Warped forests:
* **Firebloom Forest:** A bright forest with **yellow** tones. Despite its name, it isn't made of fire, but brings a unique golden atmosphere.
* **Yemson Forest:** A mysterious and dense forest featuring **green** hues, offering a striking contrast to the usual red landscapes.

## New Mobs 🐔
* **Netherrack Prowler:** A small creature similar to a Silverfish. They spawn frequently and drop **Netherrack**.
* **Debris Prowler:** Extremely rare, this Silverfish variant is a lucky find: it drops one **Ancient Debris** upon death.
* **Skeletal Chicken:** A passive, skeletal bird. A great source of **bones** while staying in the Nether.
* **Basalt Serpent:** A hostile serpent that makes exploration more challenging.

## New Ore ⛏️
* **Cobalt:** A new precious metal (equivalent to diamond)

👉 The mod also adds a new music disc created by [LaudividniYT](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g5DGJINVYxc)
